section: Governance and good governance - meaning, dimensions, World Bank/UNDP indicators

accepted.s: The 50th CPGRAMS report of the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) included the Good Governance Assessment Index (GRAI) for which period?
accepted.x: The 50th CPGRAMS report included the GRAI for June 2026. The report was associated with the 9 August 2026 governance update.
accepted.tq: Use the precise reporting period rather than the publication date.

accepted.s: In the GRAI included in the 50th CPGRAMS report, ministries were ranked on the basis of:
accepted.x: The GRAI ranked ministries using 11 indicators grouped into 4 dimensions.
accepted.tq: Separate the number of indicators from the number of dimensions.

accepted.s: In August 2026, India showcased which combination of governance mechanisms to Malaysia?
o: Mana Mitra and Single Desk Policy
CPGRAMS and the Samadhan Didi AI grievance chatbot
V-Dem and the World Governance Indicators
accepted.x: India showcased CPGRAMS and the Samadhan Didi AI grievance chatbot to Malaysia in August 2026.
accepted.tq: Match the initiative with its international demonstration context.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Mana Mitra WhatsApp Governance in Andhra Pradesh:
1. It offers more than 500 services.
2. It received an allocation of Rs 100 crore for RTGS in the 2026–27 Budget.
3. It targets 1,000 services.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Mana Mitra offers 500-plus services, received Rs 100 crore for RTGS in the 2026–27 Budget, and aims to reach 1,000 services.
accepted.tq: Verify each numerical feature separately before selecting the combined option.

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh initiative offering more than 500 services through WhatsApp and targeting 1,000 services is:
accepted.x: Mana Mitra WhatsApp Governance is the Andhra Pradesh initiative associated with more than 500 services and a target of 1,000 services.
accepted.tq: Identify the initiative from its distinctive service-delivery figures.

accepted.s: The Monthly Economic Reports of Andhra Pradesh track performance through:
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh Monthly Economic Reports use 651 key performance indicators across 30 departments.
accepted.tq: Read the indicator count and departmental coverage as a pair.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the major criticism of the Worldwide Governance Indicators (WGI) and V-Dem indices?
o: They are prepared only from citizen grievance data.
They rely exclusively on audited administrative data.
They measure only economic growth and fiscal deficit.
They are contested because they rely substantially on expert opinion and perception-based assessment.
accepted.x: WGI and V-Dem are contested because perception-based indices rely substantially on expert opinion, which can affect their objectivity and comparability.
accepted.tq: Distinguish perception-based assessment from administrative or purely economic measurement.

accepted.s: The criticism concerning perception-based governance indices such as WGI and V-Dem was highlighted in which combination of updates?
accepted.x: The criticism of WGI and V-Dem for relying on expert opinion was highlighted in the September 2026 and October 2025 discussions.
accepted.tq: Use the two distinct time references together instead of confusing them with initiative dates.
